paper_scope: Replace the original Qwen3-VL LIBERO VLA table with matched Base, original AttnRes, Full RSM-AttnRes, and inference-only native token-level ReSkip results.

hard_constraints.reskip_signal: AttnRes-native routing and RSM consistency only
hard_constraints.rsm_positioning: RSM is trained as part of Full AttnRes adaptation; ReSkip is an inference-only by-product of the same checkpoint.

training.data: IPEC-COMMUNITY LIBERO spatial/object/goal/10 no-noops LeRobot mixture
training.action_head: matched L1Regression head with eight-action horizon from the released StarVLA harness
training.additional_2B_transfer_ablation: Path-C-RSM: the same RSM-AttnRes architecture is randomly initialized and gamma is ramped from zero to one during VLA-only adaptation; it receives no VLM retrofit warm-start and no skip training.

evaluation.primary_metric: suite and four-suite mean success rate
evaluation.quality_gate: Choose the ReSkip operating point using a disjoint calibration rollout split, then evaluate once on the frozen formal seeds. No threshold selection on formal success results.
evaluation.accuracy_tolerance: Report the complete Pareto; designate a conservative operating point only if the four-suite loss versus Full RSM is no worse than 0.5 percentage points.

resource_policy.allocation: Use all currently free allowed GPUs. Never preempt unrelated jobs; enqueue remaining cells as cards are released.

deviation_policy: Any change after formal training begins must be recorded as a deviation and cannot silently replace a failed or unfavorable cell.
